content.sanskrit:
ततो रावणनीतायाः सीतायाः शत्रुकर्शनः ।
इयेष पदमन्वेष्टुं चारणाचरिते पथि ॥
content.transliteration:
tato rāvaṇanītāyāḥ sītāyāḥ śatrukarśanaḥ |
iyeṣa padam anveṣṭuṃ cāraṇācarite pathi ||
content.translation: Then the subduer of enemies, Hanuman, resolved to tread the aerial path frequented by celestial spirits, to seek the footprints of Sita who had been borne away by Ravana.
content.sanskrit_source: Ancient Valmiki verse text; digital transcription cross-checked against valmikiramayan.net.

content.sanskrit:
इयं सा पीतवसना या दृष्टा गरुडध्वजे ।
लक्षिता लक्ष्मणभ्रात्रा रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा ॥
content.transliteration:
iyaṃ sā pītavasanā yā dṛṣṭā garuḍadhvaje |
lakṣitā lakṣmaṇabhrātrā rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā ||
content.translation: This is that noble lady of pure golden attire, whom Rama of unwearied deeds described, observed by Lakshmana's elder brother.
content.sanskrit_source: Ancient Valmiki verse text; digital transcription cross-checked against valmikiramayan.net.

content.sanskrit:
वानरोऽहं महाभागे दूतो रामस्य धीमतः ।
रामनामाङ्कितं चेदं पश्य देव्यङ्गुलीयकम् ॥
content.transliteration:
vānaro'haṃ mahābhāge dūto rāmasya dhīmataḥ |
rāmanāmāṅkitaṃ cedaṃ paśya devyaṅgulīyakam ||
content.translation: O blessed lady, I am a vanara, a messenger of the wise Rama. Behold, O Queen, this ring engraved with Rama's sacred name.
content.sanskrit_source: Ancient Valmiki verse text; digital transcription cross-checked against valmikiramayan.net.

content.sanskrit:
समाश्वसिहि भद्रं ते क्षीणदुःखफला ह्यसि ।
गृहीत्वा प्रेक्षमाणा सा भर्तुः करविभूषणम् ॥
content.transliteration:
samāśvasihi bhadraṃ te kṣīṇaduḥkhaphalā hyasi |
gṛhītvā prekṣamāṇā sā bhartuḥ karavibhūṣaṇam ||
content.translation: Take comfort; blessing be upon you! The term of your sorrow is drawing to its end. Receiving and gazing upon her lord's hand-ornament, she rejoiced.
content.sanskrit_source: Ancient Valmiki verse text; digital transcription cross-checked against valmikiramayan.net.
